profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at NCR Voyix | Principal Solutions Architect at AT&T
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer & Principal Solutions Architect with 15+ years of experience designing, architecting, and delivering large-scale enterprise platforms. Cloud-certified professional specializing in modernizing legacy systems and building resilient, high-throughput architectures that support millions of daily transactions.

Expert in designing and developing framework based Micro Services and N-tier solutions using J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring, REST and SOAP APIs, Hibernate, Oracle, RabbitMQ, Messaging (JMS), Struts, Ajax, Web Services, Tomcat, BEA WebLogic, IBM WebSphere, and UML (MagicDraw, Rational Rose).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Java · Microservices · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Large Language Models (LLM) · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · Model Context Protocol (MCP)

positions.title: Principal Solutions Architect
positions.description:
• Spearheaded the initiative to migrate the Provision Automation framework (PAF) application from Private Cloud to Public Cloud, resulting in reducing infrastructure and maintenance costs by 40% and contributing to AT&T’s goal of retiring two datacenters
• Migrated on-premises VM provision process from partially provision application ICO to fully Automated PAF and retired ICO application, resulting in saving of 7 million dollars annually 
• Seamlessly integrated 25+ applications with PAF by leveraging a range of services including SOAP, Restful, RabbitMQ and JMS to effectively addresses both operational and business requirements
• Successfully integrated OpenID Connect (OIDC) with PAF, enabling robust authentication support for the system.
• Architected, designed and developed a highly distributed java container base Provision Automation 
Framework (PAF) that empowers provisioning of various flavors of Linux, Windows, and custom Application blueprints (model) into supported IaaS provider (i.e., the "cloud"), using VMWare and OpenStack APIs
• Lead development team to design and development of diverse microservice templates/seeds to facilitate the rapid development of APIs using Spring Boot, Docker, Kubernetes, and Jenkins. This resulted in significant reduction of over 200 hours per service
• Conducted rigorous concurrency testing on highly concurrent applications which required daily restart.
Identified critical dead lock and memory bottlenecks issues and resolved these issues by tuning synchronize block on reclusive function, adding connection pool on objection creation, enabling the applications to run flawlessly for weeks without any issue.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Spring Framework · Spring Boot · JDBC · Web Services · Java Message Service (JMS) · Back-End Web Development · Databases · Apache Camel · Microsoft Azure · Platform as a Service (PAAS) · RabbitMQ · Microservices · Grails · RESTful WebServices · Integration · Cloud Development · Agile Methodologies · Tomcat · Representational State Transfer (REST) · JUnit · Requirements Analysis · SQL · Cloud-Native Applications · Software as a Service (SaaS) · REST APIs · Groovy · Restlet

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Responsible for designing and developing fault tolerant integration and Cloud-ready services platform for hosting AT&T services 
• Provided guidance and proof-of-concept example codes and documents across the organizations using EIPs in Apache Camel routes to address common business use cases resulted in saving thousands of hours of design and development effort.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Framework · JDBC · Web Services · Java Message Service (JMS) · Back-End Web Development · Databases · Apache Camel · RabbitMQ · Grails · RESTful WebServices · Integration · Front-End Development · Cloud Development · Agile Methodologies · Tomcat · Representational State Transfer (REST) · JUnit · Requirements Analysis · SQL · REST APIs · Apigee · Groovy · Restlet

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
• Successfully designed and developed a highly scalable Multi-Pack Activation component capable of efficiently processing more than 1 million cards  activations per day.
• Played key role in designing the most critical components of the system to allow high concurrency and low latency to achieve an end-to-end response time of less than 100 milliseconds.
 • Led effort to design and develop the Strategic Initiatives Regression Testing Tool (SIRTT) for automatically generating test cases which helped to simulate the production scenarios and reduce the transactions failure rate significantly.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Framework · JDBC · Web Services · Java Message Service (JMS) · Back-End Web Development · Databases · Integration · Agile Methodologies · Tomcat · JUnit · Requirements Analysis · SQL

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
• Responsible for overseeing the end-to-end design and development of the J2EE application Service Parts Price Management System which is a critical component of Strategic Service Management (SSM). It has helped maximizing revenues and profits through the optimization of prices for service parts. 
• Significantly improved the search performance for parts lookup by implementing Hibernate second-level cache, resulting in an impressive 55% performance gain.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Framework · JDBC · Web Services · Java Message Service (JMS) · Back-End Web Development · Integration · Front-End Development · Tomcat · Hibernate · JUnit · Requirements Analysis · SQL

positions.title: Systems Analyst/Technical Architech
positions.description:
• Responsible for system design and architecture, ensuring it aligned with BellSouth Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) strategy and guidelines.
• Responsible for designing and developing an Access Gateway J2EE web application; an n-tier solution which provides a secured web service enabling carriers to submit pre-order queries, and firm orders efficiently and seamlessly.
 • Responsible for system design and architecture, ensuring it aligned with BellSouth Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) strategy and guidelines.
 • Responsible for designing and developing an Access Gateway J2EE web application; an n-tier solution which provides a secured web service enabling carriers to submit pre-order queries, and firm orders efficiently and seamlessly.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Framework · JDBC · Web Services · Java Message Service (JMS) · Back-End Web Development · Databases · Integration · Front-End Development · Tomcat · Hibernate · JUnit · Requirements Analysis · SQL

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
• Responsible for design and development of Policy Insight web application that provides policy administration solutions (Full-Quote, Quick Quote, Policy Inquiry, Policy Changes, in tray) for the OneBeacon insurance company. 
• Played a pivotal role in designing a vertical and reusable Insurance Application Framework (IAF) which was leveraged across multiple insurance applications to seamlessly support dynamic configurable web flows without requiring coding.
positions.insights: Skills: JDBC · Java Message Service (JMS) · Back-End Web Development · Databases · Integration · Tomcat · JUnit · Requirements Analysis · SQL

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed order entry, inventory control, catalog order entry, product configuration, distribution order entry and financial system using Visual Basic and Visual C++.
• Architected and developed COM Component interface between RF Scanner and Carton control module using Visual Basic 6.0 and Visual C++ 6.0.
• Actively involved in designing and coding Apparel Manufacturing System using Visual Basic and Oracle.  Business rules were written using stored procedures and triggers.
• Developed a warehouse management solution for Sporting Goods Company. Solution provided efficient methods for picking, packing, shipping, bin management, and bar coding.  Solution greatly improved the ordering cycles and reduced the inventory cost.
